name: falcon
draw: Falcon in a steep dive seen from the side, pointed swept-back wings folded close and a short hooked beak.

name: kestrel
draw: Small falcon hovering in place, wings raised in a V and tail fanned downward, head pointing at the ground.

draw: Osprey in flight from the side with wings angled like a gull and a fish gripped lengthwise in its talons.

draw: Hunched vulture perched in side view with a bare wrinkled head, fluffy neck ruff and heavy hooked beak.

draw: Kite raptor gliding seen from below, slender bent wings and a deeply forked tail.

draw: Eagle seen from the front with both wings raised and fully spread, head turned in profile, legs and tail below.

draw: Pelican standing in side view with a long bill and a large hanging throat pouch.

name: hornbill

name: hummingbird
